subject: Revised joint roadmap & revised close estimate — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft joint roadmap & responsibilities (post-call recap)

Sarah — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the draft joint roadmap attached so we can align on milestones, owners, and the tentative close target. High-level items we captured: 

- Business objective: reduce latency and inference cost for customer-facing search by ~60% while keeping model quality within 1% of current baseline.
- Scope: serve search ranking + chat assist in US regions initially; expand EU in phase 2.
- Proposed target pilot: 6-week pilot starting with Redwood Dedicated capacity + prefix caching and small-batch optimization.

Attached: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft — milestones, owners, dependencies). Key milestones in the MAP:
1) Legal & procurement signoff (ACME procurement) — dependency: finalized SOW & T&Cs — owner: ACME (Diego) — target: 2026-11-05
2) Pilot environment setup (networking, VPC peering, certs) — owner: Redwood (Ben) — dependency: procurement access — target: 2026-11-12
3) Model selection & quantization profile — owner: Redwood (Marissa) & ACME ML (Sarah) — target: 2026-11-18
4) Pilot validation & metrics review — joint owners — target: 2026-12-03
5) Production rollout window — tentative Q1 2027 pending pilot results

Action items for this week (owner / due):
- Karthik: circulate MAP v1 and capture ACME feedback (today) — DONE (attached)
- Sarah: share procurement contact + any required SSO details (by Thu 10/22)
- Diego: confirm licensing questions in the attached SOW redlines (by Fri 10/23)
- Ben: pre-check infra playbooks and list any network pre-reqs (by Mon 10/26)

Next meeting: propose 30 min checkpoint Fri 10/23 to confirm procurement timeline and signature owner. If that works for you, I’ll lock it.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft joint roadmap & responsibilities (post-call recap)

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Diego and I reviewed quickly. A couple of notes: 

- Procurement is the blocker here — our procurement lead (Diego) needs legal to sign off on a small set of SOW changes before we can commit. I attached a short procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf) with realistic internal gates. Our earliest realistic procurement completion is 2026-11-12, not 11/05.
- For the pilot, our infra team would like an explicit list of ports and IP ranges for the Dedicated instances; Ben, can you send that?
- We want a clarification in the MAP about data retention for logs during the pilot — can Redwood confirm retention defaults and whether they can be shortened for compliance?

We still like the proposed pilot approach. If procurement shifts to 11/12, can we move the environment setup and model selection targets accordingly? Recommend bumping pilot validation to 2026-12-10 and pushing production rollout window to late Jan 2027.

Happy to jump on the Fri checkpoint if it helps.

Thanks,
Sarah Bennett
Director, ML Infrastructure | Acme Cloud
sarah.bennett@acmecloud.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmecloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft joint roadmap & responsibilities (post-call recap)

Sarah — thanks for the procurement note and the timeline. Quick responses inline and an updated milestone plan below.

- Ports/IPs: see quick list below (we'll follow up with a one-page network playbook PDF in the shared Drive). If you have a dedicated IP allowlist, we can provide static egress ranges.
  - TCP 443 outbound to 52.34.128.0/20 (Redwood dedicated egress)
  - TCP 9000-9010 (internal agent comms) 
  - UDP 1194 (only if VPN option chosen)

- Data retention: pilot logs default to 30 days; we can reduce pilot retention to 7 days for the test instance and provide export access for audit. We'll note this in the MAP and update privacy/compliance section.

Updated MAP milestones (reflecting procurement shift you flagged):
1) Procurement/legal signoff — owner: ACME (Diego) — target: 2026-11-12 (updated)
2) Redwood infra pre-checks & rack prep — owner: Redwood (Ben) — target: 2026-11-18
3) Pilot environment setup (VPC peering, certs, customer allowlist) — owner: Redwood (Ben) — target: 2026-11-22
4) Model selection & quantization profile — owner: Redwood (Marissa) & ACME ML (Sarah) — target: 2026-11-29
5) Pilot validation & metrics review — joint owners — target: 2026-12-10
6) Production rollout planning — joint — target: 2027-01-28

I attached two files to this thread: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with these new dates) and procurement_timeline.pdf (Sarah's file). Karthik — I set aside time Mon 10/26 to run through network playbook items; want to confirm we have the right procurement owner on the Fri checkpoint.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acmecloud.com>

Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft joint roadmap & responsibilities (post-call recap)

Karthik/Ben — quick confirmation from procurement side: we reviewed the redlines and can target formal signoff on 2026-11-12 as discussed. Two small asks before we lock: 

1) Can Redwood confirm that pilot costs will be capped at a not-to-exceed amount for the initial 6-week window? If so, please provide a short cost table we can include in the SOW.
2) For SSO, our security team prefers SAML with SCIM provisioning; can you confirm Redwood supports SAML + SCIM for Dedicated deployments?

If you can hit those two items by EOD Tue 10/27 we can keep the updated timeline. Will join the Fri checkpoint to finalize.

Thanks — Diego
